lede: WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us. Most questions are answered within a few hours — often faster. If you want to book, check availability, or understand exactly what a package includes before you commit, start a message.

blocks.body_md:
**[Message us on WhatsApp →](https://wa.me/6282244788833)**

### WhatsApp (primary)

**+62 822 4478 8833**
https://wa.me/6282244788833

WhatsApp is how we handle all booking enquiries, availability checks, custom questions, and pre-trip briefings. We respond in English and Bahasa Indonesia.

### Email

**hello@javavolcano-touroperator.com**

For written records, invoice requests, or queries that don't need a fast turnaround, email works well. Response time: same-day during business hours, next-day otherwise.

**08:00–22:00 WIB (GMT+7), every day**

We are available seven days a week. Outside those hours, leave a WhatsApp message and we will pick it up first thing.

**PT Java Volcano Rendezvous**
Jl. Khairil Anwar No.102 A, Badean
Bondowoso, Jawa Timur 68214
Indonesia

[View on Google Maps →](https://www.google.com/maps?cid=1266403973589689021)

Walk-ins are not required — all bookings are handled remotely. The Bondowoso office has been at this address since the guesthouse era (2015) and through TDUP formalization in 2023.

**PT Java Volcano Rendezvous**
NIB: 1102230032918
TDUP issued: 2023-02-11

Verifiable at [oss.go.id](https://oss.go.id) (Online Single Submission registry) and the AHU corporate registry at [ahu.go.id/pencarian/perseroan](https://ahu.go.id/pencarian/perseroan).

JVTO's operating credentials — including Tourist Police affiliation (POLPAR), BBKSDA national-park authorization, HPWKI Ijen specialist membership, and ISIC Provider ID 259268 — are documented at [/verify-jvto](/verify-jvto) with SHA-256 forensic anchors.
